stories.headline: GTA 6 is the biggest launch in PlayStation history — 39 million players in four days
stories.summary: Sony says more than 39 million unique players played GTA 6 on PS5 in its first four days, with 683 million hours logged — the biggest launch across all five PlayStation generations.

stories.headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, 11 days after he resigned
stories.summary: Nvidia's board voted unanimously to bring Huang back effective immediately after pressure from Trump and Wall Street; shares jumped ~33% and reignited the AI trade.

stories.headline: GTA 6 hits 60fps on Xbox via a Quick Resume glitch — but the game speeds up too
stories.summary: A refresh-rate toggle + Quick Resume trick lifts the 30fps cap on Xbox Series X/S, but game speed is tied to frame rate, so everything runs at double speed. Digital Foundry confirmed the cap is gone.

stories.headline: COP31 fallout: EU to push reform of UN climate talks after the no-deal collapse
stories.summary: After COP31 ended with no cover decision, the EU says it will propose changes to the UN's consensus model — 'hijacked by a small minority' — while blame for the collapse is traded in public.

stories.headline: Samsung launches the world's first 1,100Hz gaming monitor — $899.99 in December
stories.summary: The 27-inch Odyssey G6 (G60H) hits 1,100Hz at 720p or 600Hz at native QHD via Dual Mode. $899.99 at US retailers from December.

stories.headline: Claude claims it proved a 47-year-old math conjecture — and no human has checked it yet
stories.summary: Anthropic posted a 70-page paper credited solely to Claude claiming VP ≠ VNP, Valiant's 1979 conjecture, with a 73,000-line Lean formalization. The repo is blunt: no human mathematician has checked the proof.
